definitions.short: Tola , the name of two Israelites
definitions.full: H8439. Towla ' II. תּוֺלָע proper name, masculine in Issachar; a judge of Israel Judg 10:1 ; assigned to earlier time by Gen 46:13 ; Num 26:23 (both P), 1Chr 7:1-2 ,(twice in verse).

occurrences.englishText: The sons of Issachar: Tola, Puvah, Iob, and Shimron.
The sons of Issachar after their families: of Tola, the family of the Tolaites; of Puvah, the family of the Punites;
After Abimelech, Tola the son of Puah, the son of Dodo, a man of Issachar, arose to save Israel. He lived in Shamir in the hill country of Ephraim.
Of the sons of Issachar: Tola, and Puah, Jashub, and Shimron, four.

The sons of Tola: Uzzi, Rephaiah, Jeriel, Jahmai, Ibsam, and Shemuel, heads of their fathers’ houses, of Tola; mighty men of valor in their generations. Their number in the days of David was twenty-two thousand six hundred.
